prompt:
Implement the core agent evolution engine for WAFT. The evolution engine must support:

1. SPAWN: Create variant agents with mutations from a base agent
2. GYM: Evaluate agent fitness using the Scint system (reality fracture detection)
3. SELECT: Choose the fittest variant based on evaluation scores
4. EVOLVE: Replace the base agent with the selected variant

Success Criteria:
- Working implementation in src/waft/core/evolution_engine.py
- Integration with existing Being system (src/waft/being.py)
- Integration with Scint detection (src/waft/evolution/scint_detector.py)
- CLI command 'waft evolve' actually works (not just placeholder)
- At least one successful test run showing spawn -> evaluate -> select cycle
- Code is documented and follows WAFT patterns

When complete, respond with: <promise>EVOLUTION_ENGINE_COMPLETE</promise>

Start by exploring what exists, then build systematically.
